subject: Login OTP not received
description: Customer is not receiving the OTP SMS while logging in on the mobile app.
resolution: SMS provider rate limit was exceeded. Increased the limit and added email OTP as a fallback.

subject: Payment deducted but order not placed
description: Amount was debited from the customer's bank account but the order status shows failed.
resolution: Payment gateway webhook timed out. Order was created manually and webhook retry was enabled.

subject: App crashes on Android 14
description: The app closes immediately after the splash screen on Android 14 devices.
resolution: Crash caused by a deprecated storage permission. Fixed in app version 3.2.1.

subject: Refund not received after 7 days
description: Customer cancelled an order but the refund has not reached their account.
resolution: Refund was stuck in pending state. Re-initiated through the gateway dashboard; refunds take 5-7 business days.

subject: Password reset link expired
description: The password reset link says expired even when opened immediately.
resolution: Server clock was out of sync causing token expiry mismatch. Synced server time with NTP.

subject: Invoice PDF shows wrong GST
description: The GST amount on the downloaded invoice does not match the checkout total.
resolution: GST rounding was applied per item instead of on the total. Fixed the invoice calculation logic.

subject: Slow dashboard loading
description: The admin dashboard takes more than 20 seconds to load reports.
resolution: Added a database index on the orders.created_at column and cached report queries. Load time reduced to 2 seconds.

subject: Unable to upload profile picture
description: Users get an error when uploading profile pictures larger than 2 MB.
resolution: Increased the upload size limit to 10 MB and added client-side image compression.

subject: Duplicate order emails
description: Customers receive the order confirmation email two or three times.
resolution: Email job was retried on timeout without an idempotency check. Added a unique message ID check.

subject: Coupon code not applying
description: Valid coupon code shows invalid at checkout.
resolution: Coupon validation was case sensitive. Made coupon matching case insensitive.
